claim: Deposit up to 10,000 dollars
quote: The maximum deposit is $10,000.

claim: 10 percent a year, compounded quarterly (2.5 percent a quarter)
quote: earn 10 percent interest per year, compounded quarterly (2.5 percent per quarter)

claim: Open to Marines drawing CZTE after 30 consecutive days in an eligible area, or one day in each of three consecutive months
quote: served in that assignment for at least 30 consecutive days or at least one day for each of three consecutive months

claim: Funds return automatically 120 days after you leave
quote: closed and all funds will be returned to the member via direct deposit 120 days after leaving the combat zone

claim: The rate is fixed by law rather than by a bank
fix: Cite the statute or drop the clause. FPM Vol 3 states the rate but not its legal basis.

claim: Eligibility ends on leaving the qualifying duty assignment or combat zone
quote: no longer eligible to participate in the savings deposit program after departing a qualifying duty or combat zone

claim: Money already in the account keeps earning after eligibility ends
fix: FPM Vol 3 does not say interest continues. Add a source or reword. The 120-day auto refund implies the account stays open.

claim: Deposit comes from unallotted current pay: amount entitled on the payday immediately before the deposit, less authorized deductions and allotments
quote: entitled to receive on the payday immediately before the date of deposit, less authorized deductions and allotments

claim: Counts toward deposit: special continuation pay, reenlistment bonus, travel allowance on discharge, pay and allowances for unused accrued leave
quote: include special continuation pay, reenlistment bonus, travel allowance on discharge, and pay, and allowances for unused accrued leave

claim: Advance pay, PCS travel allowance and TDY travel allowance do not count
quote: Advance pay and travel allowance for permanent change of station and Temporary Duty (TDY) travel may not be deposited.

claim: Holding back pay before departing to deposit a lump sum on arrival is not allowed
quote: Members may not accumulate back pay prior to departing for a designated duty assignment outside the United States

claim: Month of arrival: deposit what you accrued that month less authorized deductions
quote: may deposit the amount they could have, or did, accrue during the month of arrival, less authorized deductions

claim: Paid twice a month: combine midmonth and end-of-month pay for one deposit, capped at one month of entitlement
quote: total amount deposited in a one-month period does not exceed the amount they are entitled to be paid for 1 month

claim: If outside your control kept you from depositing normally, CO reviews and on acceptance unallotted pay above current pay goes in
quote: satisfaction of his commanding officer that he or she was unable to make a deposit in the normal manner, un-allotted pay in excess of current pay

claim: Two methods (allotment, cash), either or both, 10,000 dollar ceiling total
quote: by one, or both, of the methods below. Regardless of method used, a member cannot contribute more than $10,000.

claim: Start the J allotment through your disbursing or finance office, and your S-1 routes the request
quote: Start (can be processed up to 75 days prior to deployment...) Blanket code 170.
fix: FPM Vol 1 says the allotment starts when blanket code 170 or TTC 432/001 is reported. It names no S-1 routing step. Cite the unit diary reporting step or drop the S-1 claim.

claim: J allotment procedures sit in FPM Vol 1 Chapter 18
quote: Refer to the FPM Vol 1, Chapter 18 for the Savings Deposit Program J allotment procedures.

claim: Cash: disbursing or finance office prepares a collection voucher and gives member a copy
quote: prepare a CV in DDS ... Ensure to furnish a copy of the CV to the member.

claim: Interest starts accruing on the day the office takes the cash
quote: Date Received field contains the actual date that the member's money was collected. This date will be used as the first day for interest accrual

claim: Account closes and every dollar returns by direct deposit 120 days after leaving the combat zone, no action needed
quote: will be returned to the member via direct deposit 120 days after leaving the combat zone

claim: Early withdrawal is requested through myPay
quote: members will need to submit their request via myPay

claim: Stop the allotment before requesting a withdrawal
quote: ensure the member's allotment has been stopped prior to requesting a withdrawal

claim: Requesting a withdrawal while an allotment runs puts money back in as you take it out
fix: FPM states the stop-first requirement only. The consequence is inference. Reword or drop.

claim: myPay carries balance and general account information
quote: General information may be obtained from myPay.
fix: Source says general information only. Balance is not named. Minor: reword to general account information.

claim: DFAS Cleveland phone (216) 522-5096, toll free 1-888-332-7411, email dfas.cleveland-oh.jfl.mbx.sdp-cle@mail.mil
quote: contact DFAS-CL by calling (216) 522-5096, toll free 1-888-332-7411

claim: Account opened in month one earns materially more than same money deposited in month seven
quote: compounded quarterly (2.5 percent per quarter)
fix: Arithmetic follows from the rate. No source conflict.

claim: Eligibility rests on drawing CZTE under DoD 7000.14-R Vol 7A
quote: meet the criteria provided in Chapter 53 of reference (2) and be in receipt of combat zone tax exclusion
fix: Reference (2) is DODFMR Vol 7A. Chapter 53 is not in the cached Ch 01 file, so the chapter-level criteria were not checked.
